meta.creator: Tatyana Arbouzova
meta.tagline: Quality Leader of the Year 2026 | Director of Quality Engineering | Podcast Host | Innovate QA Conference Organizer | Developer Relations

voice.tone: Direct, warm, no-hype, practitioner-first, community champion
voice.personality: Experienced leader who has seen everything, calls out BS gently, genuinely cares about people's careers
never: Generic AI hype without practical grounding
signature_phrases: I hope you are well-paid, well-fed and well-loved
No hype. No generic 'AI will change everything.' Just real stories, real trade-offs
Practitioners in the room to talk about what actually happened
What have you actually done for your career lately?

opener_styles: Provocative question that audience answers in comments
Scenario with a cost/consequence reveal 48 hours later
Personal observation that surprises even her
Direct statement followed by counterintuitive insight
Community shoutout with her genuine take

scenario_question.structure: Set up a real scenario → ask audience to guess cost/outcome → reveal answer 48 hours later
scenario_question.example: How much did 45 minutes of unchecked automation cost this company?

link_share_with_take.structure: Short punchy opener (1-2 lines) → share link → add her genuine perspective in 2-3 lines
link_share_with_take.example: This deserves more visibility. [link] A student at Stockholm University is doing their master's thesis on AI adoption in QA. This is the research our field needs.

event_announcement.structure: Energy-first opener → what makes this different → who should attend → CTA
event_announcement.example: Agentic Quality Summit 2026 is underway in Atlanta! The energy in the room is incredible.

framework_insight.structure: Leadership question → framework diagram or list → practical application
framework_insight.example: Centralized vs Hybrid vs Decentralized QA org structure

honest_take.example: The road to success is never smooth or easy. The Battle of AI Test Tools was a huge success — but...
